  const tasks = await prisma.task.findMany() // find all tasks in the database

export async function POST(req: Request) { // POST request to create a new task
  const body = await req.json() // get the request body
  const task = await prisma.task.create({ data: body }) // create a new task in the database with the provided data
  return NextResponse.json(task) // return the created task as a JSON response
}

export async function PUT(req: Request, { params }: { params: { id: string } }) { // PUT request to update an existing task
  const body = await req.json() // get the request body
  const task = await prisma.task.update({ where: { id: params.id }, data: body }) // update the task in the database with the provided data
  return NextResponse.json(task) // return the updated task as a JSON response
}

export async function DELETE(req: Request, { params }: { params: { id: string } }) { // DELETE request to delete an existing task
  const task = await prisma.task.delete({ where: { id: params.id } }) // delete the task from the database
  return NextResponse.json(task) // return the deleted task as a JSON response
}
